title: Loki retention_period shorter than the minimum
fix: retention_period: 8760h (365 days) for PCI DSS; 4320h (180 days) for CERT-In; 21912h (913 days) for OMB M-21-31

title: Loki retention_stream period shorter than the minimum
fix: period: 8760h, or drop the stream override for audit selectors

title: Log group RetentionInDays shorter than the minimum
where: AWS::Logs::LogGroup, SAM, Serverless logRetentionInDays, Azure Log Analytics retentionInDays

title: Cloud Logging bucket retentionDays shorter than the minimum
ILM/ISM delete phase starts before the minimum
where: Elasticsearch ILM or OpenSearch ISM policy, delete phase min_age
fix: min_age: 365d on the delete phase (PCI DSS), 180d (CERT-In), 913d (OMB M-21-31)

title: kube-apiserver --audit-log-maxage shorter than the minimum
where: kube-apiserver static pod manifest or kubeadm ClusterConfiguration extraArgs
fix: --audit-log-maxage=365, or ship the audit log to a store that keeps it 365 days

title: S3 lifecycle expires log objects before the minimum
where: S3 LifecycleConfiguration ExpirationInDays / Expiration Days on a log or audit bucket

title: Logs move to an archive tier before the immediately-available window ends
where: S3 lifecycle Transition to GLACIER or DEEP_ARCHIVE
fix: TransitionInDays: 90 or later (PCI DSS 3 months immediately available); 365 or later for OMB M-21-31 active storage

title: Log store region outside Indian jurisdiction
where: region / location keys when the file declares the cert-in profile
fix: ap-south-1 or ap-south-2 (AWS), asia-south1 or asia-south2 (GCP), centralindia / southindia / westindia (Azure)
